blind_solve_config.init_position: truth + random horizontal offset (NOT the surveyed coordinate)
blind_solve_config.solver: spp.solve_spp_nonlinear (iterative weighted least-squares from wrong init)
blind_solve_config.convergence: iterates until dx < 0.01 m or max_iter=20
blind_solve_config.description: The blind solve starts from a position 100 km wrong and converges using only the TEP clock prior + k pseudoranges. This is a true navigation solve, not a mechanism diagnostic linearised at the truth.

clock_preprocessing.description: dejump + trend fit on history strictly before each window start g0; cumulative steering offset frozen at g0; in-window steering events are NOT repaired (honest tail) and counted as steering-flagged epochs

integrity_boundary.required_for_operational_closure: receiver steering-event telemetry or independent position/motion constraint

tep_covariance.predicted_quantity: absolute causal residual (Step 55/56: trend + kriged live reference residuals)

phase_resolved_covariance.psd_guarantee: Schur product (Hadamard of distance covariance and spectral Gram)

tep_calibrated.sigma_range_m: MAD or 84th-percentile kriging error on pre-window, clipped [3.0, 50.0] m

astronomical_features.source: JPL DE432s ephemeris + known orbital mechanics

features.tep_aniso_vel: Anisotropic kriging, preferred axis = orbital velocity direction (Paper 2: r=-0.888)
features.tep_aniso_cmb: Anisotropic kriging, preferred axis = CMB dipole (Paper 2: r=0.747)
features.tep_aniso_grav: Anisotropic kriging, preferred axis = stacked planetary gravity vector (Mercury+Venus+Mars+Jupiter+Saturn, JPL ephemeris)
features.tep_aniso_tidal: Anisotropic kriging, preferred axis = combined solar+lunar tidal axis (M/r^3 weighted, JPL ephemeris)
features.tep_aniso_bary: Anisotropic kriging, preferred axis = Earth barycentric acceleration (total solar system gravity, JPL ephemeris)
features.tep_harmonic: Isotropic kriging + 10-harmonic correction (semiannual, 18.6yr, Chandler, synodic, anomalistic, draconic, sidereal day, solar day, S2 12h, S3 8h)
features.tep_diurnal_harm: Isotropic kriging + diurnal-only harmonic correction (sidereal, solar, S2, S3)
features.tep_event_aware: Isotropic kriging + event-aware blending (Paper 2: 5.5x effect at planetary events)
features.tep_tvar_lambda: Isotropic kriging with time-varying lambda (annual modulation ~9.5%)
features.tep_astronomical_full: Velocity anisotropy + full harmonic + event-aware blending
features.tep_stacked_full: Stacked gravity anisotropy + full harmonic + event-aware blending

tidal_computations.stacked_gravity: Vector sum of G*M_i*(r_i-r_earth)/|r_i-r_earth|^3 for 5 planets
tidal_computations.bary_accel: Finite-difference 2nd derivative of Earth barycentric position
